CFML Language Reference: Functions

ListRest

Returns everything in a list after the first element. If the list has only one element, or none, the result is an empty string.

Category

List functions

Syntax

ListRest(list [, delimiters ])

Parameters

list
The list.
delimiters
Optional. The delimiter characters of the list; the default is a comma.

Returns

The rest of the list.

Usage

Delimiters at the start of the remaining list are removed. Together with ListFirst, ListRest lets you process a list like a stack: take the first element, then carry on with the rest, as the example does.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Queue = "Alice,Bob,Carol,Dave">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Now serving</TH><TH>Still waiting</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP CONDITION="Len(Queue) GT 0">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD>#ListFirst(Queue)#</TD><TD>#ListRest(Queue)#&nbsp;</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
<CFSET Queue = ListRest(Queue)>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>

See also

ListFirst, ListLast, ListDeleteAt, GetToken
